value.rationale: This locates a genuine failure of recovery with a half-period budget even when all spatial ranks are observed, and quantifies exactly how badly that budget fails at its first odd-prime obstruction. The jump to guaranteed recovery at seven and the multiplicities separating typical from ambiguous observations are meaningful benchmarks for shorter ordinal inversion. This is not a claim of an asymptotic law or an efficient inverse for arbitrary prime lengths.
